units.source_text: 凡斋宫受任命后，先行祓禊，

en.t: In general, after a Saigu was appointed, she first performed purification rites,

units.source_text: 入禁中左卫门府斋戒若干日，此时称为入初斋院。

en.t: then entered the Left Gate Guards' office within the palace and observed ritual abstinence for several days; this was called entering the first purification residence.

units.source_text: 然后举行第二次祓禊，移居京都西北角的嵯峨野宫修行一年。

en.t: After that, she performed a second purification rite and moved to the Saganomiya palace in the northwest corner of Kyoto to undergo training for one year.
Only then did she proceed to Ise.
